_comment: ✅ DESIGN §9.3: v0 has five of the seven major posts — treasury, garrison, works, granary, market. Temple and tribal relations wait for their versions. Change this file, not code. minRank gates a post on the holder's gravitas rank (DESIGN §9.2).

posts.name: Treasurer
posts.description: Guards the denarii. Lowers corruption when held by a disciplined man of your own house.

posts.name: Prefect of the garrison
posts.description: Commands the militia. His discipline adds to the walls.

posts.name: Curator of works
posts.description: Oversees construction. His craft shortens build times.

posts.name: Prefect of the granary
posts.description: Manages the fields and the granary. His craft raises grain yields.

posts.name: Aedile of the market
posts.description: Runs the market. His connections raise denarii income.

_lesserComment: DESIGN §9.3: posts outside the council. Less gravitas, less threat — a lesser post keeps a house content without handing it leverage, and it cannot be used to obstruct, skim or leak. `effect` names what the holder's stat feeds, and `perStat` how much per point.

lesser.name: Scribe of the tablets
lesser.description: Keeps the records straight. Corruption falls a little faster.

lesser.name: Surveyor
lesser.description: Sets out the lines. Construction goes a little quicker.

lesser.name: Diviner
lesser.description: Reads the entrails before the council sits. Your office gains standing.

lesser.name: Herald
lesser.description: Carries your word to the houses. Their regard cools more slowly.

lesser.name: Warden of the gate
lesser.description: Keeps the watch. A little more strength on the walls.
